LOGIC ADVENTURE 5 · CLASS 30

Bear’s Big-to-Small Parade

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Size ordering

Four bears, one parade — tap them from biggest to smallest so the parade can march.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · SIZE ORDERING

Bear’s Big-to-Small Parade

The bears march biggest to smallest! Tap the biggest bear first, then the next, until the littlest.

Tap the bears from biggest to smallest.

Parade ordered!

Biggest to smallest — what a tidy parade.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Comparing sizes across a whole set is harder than comparing two. Ask "which is the biggest one left?" each round — the words biggest and smallest do the teaching.

Prefer paper? The Bear’s Big-to-Small Parade worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
